title: HKEX Main Board Listing Rules Appendix C2, Environmental, Social and Governance Reporting Code, Part D climate-related disclosures
citation: HKEX Main Board Listing Rules Appendix C2 (ESG Code) Part D; 2024 Amendments (consultation conclusions April 2024)
evidence: HKEX ESG FAQ (opened https://www.hkex.com.hk/Listing/Sustainability/ESG-Academy/Rules-and-Regulations?sc_lang=en on 2026-11-02): "For financial years commencing on or after 1 January 2025: all Main Board listed issuers are required to report on the climate-related disclosure requirements set out in Part D of the ESG Code (Climate Requirements) on a “comply or explain” basis"; "For financial years commencing on or after 1 January 2026, all Hang Seng Composite LargeCap Index constituents are required to report on the Climate Requirements on a mandatory basis."
status_note: Part D is comply or explain for Main Board issuers from financial years commencing on or after 2025-01-01; mandatory for Hang Seng Composite LargeCap Index constituents from financial years commencing on or after 2026-01-01.
notes: Row HK-HKEX-ADOPTED is permission requested (HKEX Terms of Use bar copying and scripted access). The rulebook site https://en-rules.hkex.com.hk/ failed TLS verification from the cloud address, so the rule text itself was not opened; the date comes from the HKEX FAQ page. No official English translation site applies (English is an official language).

title: Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), section 388 and Schedule 5, directors’ report business review (environmental policies and performance, compliance)
evidence: Cap. 622 as served in the DATA.GOV.HK bulk file hkel_c_leg_cap_601_cap_end_en.zip (version 2025-05-23, opened 2026-11-02): commencement line "[3 March 2014]" and editorial note "Commencement date: 3 March 2014."; Schedule 5 para 2: "a business review must include ... (b) a discussion on— (i) the company’s environmental policies and performance; and (ii) the company’s compliance with the relevant laws and regulations that have a significant impact on the company".
notes: Date is the commencement of the Ordinance; the bulk file shows Schedule 5 in a later operational period (start 2019-02-01) because of amendments, and no earlier Schedule 5 version was read. Row is permission requested, so no text is stored. Chinese text is equally authentic; English is the stored language if the row passes.

notes: Voluntary until a regulator or authority mandates use, per HKICPA (from search summary of the HKICPA text; the release page was read only for the effective date). Row is permission requested (HKICPA terms: non-commercial, no modification).

title: Hong Kong Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance (HKMA)
